name: Exchange Rate Type 3 Code
definition: Code used to define the type of the currency exchange.

SELL.name: Sell
SELL.definition: Exchange rate is the Sell rate.

MIDL.name: Middle
MIDL.definition: Exchange rate is the Middle rate.

BUYR.name: Buy
BUYR.definition: Exchange rate is the Buy rate.

AGRD.name: Agreed
AGRD.definition: Exchange rate applied is the rate agreed between the parties.
